equity.level_reason: The outcome (problems paying medical bills) is a social-determinant measure compared by disability status, but values are only set side by side (21.2% vs 9.6%) with no computed difference or ratio, so the cap at 2 applies.

level_alternative.reason: With an SDOH outcome, the 'higher' contrast with stated percentages could be read as quantified; or level 1 if disability is read as a functional rather than social-position dimension.
